research.facts:
Cade Horton TJ recovery — return July/August 2027
**Status:** NEW ANGLE (Oct 18 mentioned Horton in the rotation crisis aggregate. Today = standalone deep-dive on TJ timeline and what it means for 2027 rotation building.)
**Key facts:**
- Surgery date: April 16, 2026 (Daily Herald, MLB.com)
- Procedure: Full Tommy John (2nd in same elbow) + flexor repair + internal brace
- Recovery window: 15-16 months from April 2026 → return **July or August 2027**
- Craig Counsell quote: "So they repaired the flexor and the brace, so it's the 15-, 16-month recovery."
- This is Horton's second TJ in his right elbow (first was in college)
- Second-TJ recovery "runs longer than usual" per multiple sources
- Cubs need 3 starters via FA/trade before Horton is back
**Sources:**
- MLB.com: Jed Hoyer comments on Horton injury
- MDJ Online: "Cubs RHP Cade Horton recovering from Tommy John surgery" — 15-16 month timeline
- Daily Herald (April 17, 2026): "Pitching problems: Palencia goes on IL as Horton gets recovery timeline"
- Heavy.com: "Cubs Cade Horton Return Timeline: What to Expect After 2nd Tommy John Surgery" — July/August 2027
**Confidence:** HIGH on surgery date, procedure type, timeline. MEDIUM on specific return month (range-based).
**Why it matters:** Horton won't be available for spring training or the first half of 2027. Cubs must build an entire rotation without him for at least the first 100 games.

research.facts:
Gold Glove outfield sweep — PCA, Happ, Suzuki hunting history
**Status:** FOLLOW UP (Oct 16 covered Cubs' 5 GG finalists broadly. Today = narrowed focus on outfield sweep milestone angle.)
**Key facts:**
- Cubs have 5 NL finalists: PCA (CF), Happ (LF), Suzuki (RF), Swanson (SS), Bregman (3B)
- All three outfielders winning = **first team ever to sweep all 3 outfield Gold Gloves in same season** (MLB.com)
- PCA (Pete Crow-Armstrong): Called the "biggest lock" among Cubs finalists
- Happ: 4 consecutive GG awards entering 2026; faces Jackson Chourio (Brewers LF, 6 FRV vs Happ's 5 FRV) — competitive
- Suzuki: 8 FRV, 5 OAA in RF; Corbin Carroll (ARI) led all RF with 10 OAA and 9 runs prevented — Suzuki is not the favorite
- GG voted by MLB personnel (75%) + SABR Defensive Index (25%)
- Winners announced: Nov. 1, 2026 on ESPN at 8:30 PM ET
**Sources:**
- MLB.com: "Could Cubs' best-in-show defense become 1st ever to sweep outfield Gold Gloves?" (official MLB piece)
- Bleacher Nation (Oct 14): Cubs 5 finalists confirmed
- Roundtable (Oct 14): Cubs lead NL with 5 finalists
**Confidence:** HIGH on finalist names. HIGH on Nov. 1 date. MEDIUM on "first ever to sweep" claim (MLB.com is primary, authoritative source).
**Why it matters:** With Suzuki and Happ potentially departing, the outfield Gold Gloves could be their farewell to Wrigley. PCA represents the future.
